name: fastapi_router_prefix
description: Cross-file path resolution. The version prefix is applied by app.include_router(api_router, prefix="/api/v1") in app/main.py, the resource prefixes come from APIRouter(prefix=...) in app/api/routes/*.py, and an intermediate aggregate router sits between them. Resolving the real URL requires following include_router calls across three files. This is the full-stack-fastapi-template layout, so getting it wrong means getting the canonical integration target wrong.
notes: If DocZot reports paths without the /api/v1 prefix it will fail the endpoint assertion here even though it found the right number of routes. That is intended: a coverage report that names URLs the service does not actually serve is not usable, and cross-referencing docs against those wrong paths is how documented endpoints get misreported as gaps. The trailing slash on /invoices/ follows from @router.get("/") on a prefixed router.
